Hi Alice — attaching what we can share immediately and documenting the controls here inline for ease of review. Full bundle uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NimbleEvidenceShare (link shared with your security address).

Background screening
- Vendor: ClearCheck Inc. (contracted 2019, vendor SOC2 Type II available on request)
- Scope: ID verification, national criminal record search, global sanctions & watchlists, employment verification (role-dependent).
- Typical turnaround: 24–72 hours (average ~48 hours).
- Redactions: we provide redacted PDFs that mask PII; we leave last4 of SSN only when needed for matching. See attached "nimble-redacted-background-sample.pdf".

Training exports (Q1 2027)
- File: security-training-completion-q1-2027.csv (attached). Columns: employee_id_hashed, role, course_name, completion_timestamp, status.
- Completion snapshot (Q1 2027): Security Fundamentals: 98% completed; Role-based secure dev ops: 94% completed; Phishing simulation participation: 100% (campaigns run quarterly).

Onboarding / Offboarding controls
- Runbook: "onboard-offboard-runbook-v1.2.pdf" attached (last updated 2027-01-15). Includes account creation checklist, entitlements approval flow, and standard deprovision checklist.
- SLA for access revocation on termination: standard is 24 hours for active directory/cloud accounts; critical systems (databases, KMS access) targeted within 4 hours after termination event when triggered by HR/SCIM.
- Deprovision evidence: we can provide a sample audit log extract showing deprovision timestamps for a recent leaver (redacted).

Other notes
- Screening history: consolidated summary attached "clearcheck-screening-summary-2019-2027.xlsx" (counts by check type and pass/fail rates).
- We are able to provide a short attestation letter confirming the extracts are representative; let us know if you prefer a signed PDF.

Attachments (attached to this thread):
- nimble-redacted-background-sample.pdf (redacted demo report)
- security-training-completion-q1-2027.csv (hashed IDs only)
- onboard-offboard-runbook-v1.2.pdf
- clearcheck-screening-summary-2019-2027.xlsx

If you need specific fields added to the CSV (hire date, manager), tell us and we can regenerate with minimal PII exposure.

Thanks,
